bed_t1.name: Sturdy Cot
bed_t1.desc: A proper place to sleep. Fully restores HP, stamina, and focus when resting at home.

workshop_t1.name: Basic Workshop
workshop_t1.desc: Workbench, hand tools, and parts bins. Unlocks workshop crafting at home.

workshop_t2.name: Advanced Workshop
workshop_t2.desc: Sturdier benches and tools. Reduces crafting DC by 1 and unlocks advanced workbench recipes.

workshop_t3.name: Master Workshop
workshop_t3.desc: Precision gear and stock. Reduces crafting DC by 2 and unlocks masterwork blueprints.

kitchen_t1.name: Camp Kitchen
kitchen_t1.desc: A burner, pot, and utensils. Unlocks simple cooking at home.

kitchen_t2.name: Field Kitchen
kitchen_t2.desc: Adds oven and herbs. Reduces cooking DC by 1 and unlocks hearty recipes.

kitchen_t3.name: Chef's Kitchen
kitchen_t3.desc: Full pantry and gear. Reduces cooking DC by 2 and unlocks gourmet recipes.

studio_t1.name: Art Studio
studio_t1.desc: Canvas, pigments, and a drafting table. Unlocks art creation and selling at home.

studio_t2.name: Drafting Studio
studio_t2.desc: Better lighting and tools. Reduces art DC by 1 and unlocks detailed pieces.

studio_t3.name: Master Studio
studio_t3.desc: Premium materials and space. Reduces art DC by 2 and unlocks masterworks.

forgery_t1.name: Forgery Bench
forgery_t1.desc: Seals, inks, and lamp-black. Unlocks basic forgery at home.

forgery_t2.name: Forgery Lab
forgery_t2.desc: Special inks and presses. Reduces forgery DC by 1 and unlocks complex documents.

forgery_t3.name: Master Forgery Suite
forgery_t3.desc: Precision tools and archives. Reduces forgery DC by 2 and unlocks masterpiece forgeries.
